inputs.text:
Wake up and see through the theater they are scripting for us. That graduation ceremony in Jaipur with the Deputy Chief Minister is being pushed as some kind of spontaneous student outburst, but that official narrative is a complete inversion of reality. It is a carefully orchestrated distraction script designed to keep the public divided and looking the other way with talk of "administrative issues," "student rights," and "inappropriate" behavior. 

Why is the university administration conveniently remaining silent? It is all part of a coordinated blackout to manage the perception of the masses. They use these engineered spectacles to manipulate public conversation and hide the real levers of control operating behind the scenes of these educational institutions. Do not fall for it.
